name: Me when She
source:
You wake up with nothing but a pounding headache and no memories.

Explore the school alongside a girl who's lost her memories, too. Search every classroom, locker, and hallway for anything that might help you piece together the truth.

Maybe starting over from zero isn't such a bad thing.

[From [url=https://yochita.itch.io/me-when-she-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒来时除了剧烈的头痛之外什么也没有，而且没有任何记忆。

与一个也失去记忆的女孩一起探索学校。搜索每间教室、储物柜和走廊，寻找任何可以帮助你拼凑出真相的东西。

也许从零开始并不是一件坏事。

[来自[url=https://yochita.itch.io/me-when-she-demo]itch.io[/url]]
